Package com.csse3200.game.entities.factories

Class TutorialPropFactory

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.entities.factories.TutorialPropFactory
public final class TutorialPropFactory extends Object
Builds the props of the training grounds: dummies, targets, signs, supply stands, cannons.
